description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity for a Registered Nurse passionate about overseeing comprehensive nursing operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care. We are looking to fill this vital role by June 30th, so prompt application is encouraged.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in guiding our nursing team, implementing best practices, and maintaining regulatory compliance. Your leadership will directly impact the quality of life for our residents and foster a supportive environment for our staff. This role offers a chance to make a significant difference in a community-focused setting.

This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, commensurate with your experience and expertise. Join a team committed to excellence and compassionate care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing (DON) or in a similar nursing leadership role
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
Commitment to quality patient care and staff development
